HOTEL.definition: The hotel as a whole, covering overall opinions, general value for money, overall quality, cleanliness or comfort of the hotel in general, and other aspects not attributable to a more specific entity.

ROOMS.definition: The guest rooms or suites themselves, including their size, cleanliness, comfort, design, view, noise and price.

ROOMS_AMENITIES.definition: Specific items and equipment inside the rooms, such as the bed, bathroom, shower, air conditioning, TV, minibar, furniture and in-room internet.

FACILITIES.definition: Facilities of the hotel outside the rooms, such as the pool, gym, spa, lobby, restaurant premises, parking, elevators, beach area and public internet access.

SERVICE.definition: The service and staff of the hotel, including reception, check-in and check-out, housekeeping, room service, helpfulness, friendliness and professionalism of personnel.

LOCATION.definition: The location of the hotel, including its neighbourhood, proximity to attractions, shops, beach or transport, accessibility and the surrounding view.

FOOD_DRINKS.definition: The food and beverages offered by the hotel, such as breakfast, buffet, restaurant meals, drinks and their quality, variety and price.
